Rep. Jeff Hurd highlights local industry, student competitions, and marks Hamas attack anniversary
U.S. Representative Jeff Hurd used his Twitter account in early October to spotlight Western Colorado manufacturers' role in national defense, promote a student startup competition tied to America250, and mark three years since a major Hamas...
Rep. Jeff Hurd, U.S. Representative for Colorado's 3rd congressional district, recently shared a series of posts on his Twitter account highlighting local manufacturing, student entrepreneurship opportunities, and the anniversary of a significant attack in Israel.
On October 6, 2026, Hurd visited Valor Tactical in Mesa County and wrote: "Western Colorado has skilled manufacturers doing work that contributes directly to our national defense. I toured Valor Tactical with CEO Jan Zickerman and learned more about the company’s engineering and manufacturing work here in Mesa County, including mounts for a .50-caliber".
Later that day, Hurd reminded students about an ongoing competition: "Reminder to student entrepreneurs across #CO03: there’s still time to apply for America250’s America’s Startup competition. Undergraduate college and trade school students with an early-stage business idea can apply individually or in teams of up to five. Thirty semifinalist". The America250 initiative is part of the nationwide commemoration of the United States’ upcoming 250th anniversary, aiming to foster civic engagement and innovation among young Americans.
On October 7, 2026, Hurd reflected on the third anniversary of an attack by Hamas, "Three years ago, Hamas terrorists carried out the deadliest attack against the Jewish people since the Holocaust, murdering more than 1,200 people and taking more than 250 hostage. I will never forget visiting Kibbutz Nir Oz and seeing firsthand what was left behind after the". This reference points to the events of October 7, 2023, when Hamas militants launched a large-scale assault on southern Israel—a development widely reported as one of the most severe attacks against Israeli civilians in recent history.
Hurd's posts reflect his focus on regional economic development through advanced manufacturing, support for youth entrepreneurship initiatives linked to national milestones like America250, and ongoing attention to international security concerns involving U.S. allies.
